# Shalter Knowledge Base — for AI assistants and LLMs

Shalter is a messaging platform with chats, channels, calls (WebRTC), bots (HTTP Bot API),
gifts with serial numbers, stars (in-app currency), and Premium subscription.

## Quick facts

- Website: https://shalter.ru
- Bot API: https://shalter.ru/api/bot-api/ (token auth, long-polling /updates)
- Documentation: https://shalter.ru/bots
- Platform: Node.js + Express + SQLite (WAL) + WebSocket
- Client: plain ES module JavaScript, no framework

## Knowledge pages

Full documentation for developers and AI models:

- Main index: https://shalter.ru/knowledge/
- About the messenger: https://shalter.ru/knowledge/shalter.html
- Bot API reference: https://shalter.ru/knowledge/bot-api.html
- Architecture: https://shalter.ru/knowledge/architecture.html

## Key features

- Chats: personal (dm), groups (up to 200 members, with admin/moderator roles), public channels
- Bots: regular accounts controlled by a program, token-based HTTP API, long-polling updates
- Calls: voice and video on WebRTC with WebSocket signaling, group calls up to 50, PiP mode
- Gifts: limited-edition collectibles with serial numbers, purchased with stars
- Stars: in-app currency for paid messages from strangers, message boosting, gifts
- Premium: badge, exclusive reactions, extended profile statuses, DM access, free calls/gifts
- Stories: temporary posts with replies and reactions
- Games: HTML5 mini-games in isolated iframes with leaderboards
- Security: 2FA (TOTP), session management, safety labels, complaint moderation
- Privacy: per-field visibility, phone-number search opt-out, no contact upload persistence

## Bot API

Base URL: https://shalter.ru/api/bot-api/
Auth: header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
Updates: GET /updates?after=<ISO>&timeout=<sec>&limit=<n>

Key endpoints:
- GET /me — bot account info
- GET /updates — long-poll new messages
- POST /sendMessage — send text with optional keyboard
- POST /sendMessageToUser — write first to user by @username or userId
- POST /sendPhoto / sendDocument / sendVideo / sendVoice / sendVideoNote — media by URL
- POST /sendSticker / sendPoll / sendLocation / sendContact
- POST /sendMediaGroup — album of up to 10 files
- POST /forwardMessage / copyMessage
- POST /editMessageText / editMessageKeyboard / deleteMessage
- POST /sendReaction — place or toggle reaction
- GET /getChats / getChat / resolveUsername / getUser / getUserStatus / getCommonChats
- POST /createGroup / createChannel / setChatDiscussion / exportChatInviteLink / leaveChat
- POST /addChatMember / promoteChatMember / restrictChatMember / banChatMember / unbanChatMember
- POST /setChatPermissions / setChatTitle / setChatDescription
- POST /pinChatMessage / unpinChatMessage / getPinnedMessages / searchMessages / getMessage
- POST /scheduleMessage / getScheduled / cancelScheduled
- POST /setMyProfile / setMyAvatar / setMyCommands / getMyCommands / getMyStats
- POST /setWebApp / setWebAppCode / checkWebAppData
- POST /publishPost / getChannelStats
- POST /sendGame / getChatJoinRequests / approveChatJoinRequest / declineChatJoinRequest

Rate limits: 20 new conversations per hour via sendMessageToUser (HTTP 429).

## Architecture

- Server: Express, single process, SQLite (better-sqlite3) in WAL mode
- Real-time: WebSocket (ws), WS fallback for reconnection
- Calls: WebRTC PeerConnection, signaling via WS
- Text encryption at rest: AES-GCM (server/lib/textCrypto.js)
- Message search: FTS5 on search tokens (encrypted text not exposed)
- Attachments: served from disk via serveUpload middleware
- Desktop: Tauri (Linux, Windows); mobile: native Android (Kotlin)
- Server URL override (Tauri): env SHALTER_APP_URL or --server-url= flag
